question: What does the menu on the URL tab of the link editor show, and what does each entry write?
page: Gestures Probe, new blocks, never saved

menu.pill: URL 96 by 28 at 22,22 in the popover; Email 105 wide, Phone 111 wide; the chevron turns up while the menu is open; a click on the pill opens and closes it
menu.box: 142 wide, 56 below the popover's top, left with the pill
rows: a check on the current kind
small caps with an info icon
menu.onText: the same four kinds and Learn more from the text toolbar's Link
menu.escape: 1 read: Escape with the menu open closes the whole editor

file.shows: Search files, an upload button, Open link in new tab on; popover 320 by 150
file.notUsed: no file chosen and nothing uploaded (decision 0005)

popover.centredOn: the control it opened from: Attach link's centre is 505. Reopened from Edit, centre 544.5: URL top 461, Phone 457, Email 305, Email with CC and BCC 295
popover.text: the top stays at 289 for URL, Email and Phone; left 337
popover.height: 500 is the most; with CC and BCC the fields scroll inside

email.fields: To (placeholder Enter email address), CC, BCC, Subject, Body. CC and BCC are buttons; a press adds that field above Subject and focuses it. A field with a value has Clear on To, CC and BCC; Subject and Body have none
email.button: the href follows every change. Enter in To leaves the editor open
email.text: no link until the close; Enter in Subject left the editor open; the close wrote <a href="mailto:a@example.com?subject=Hi%20there">, reopened with the fields filled
email.undo: after To, Subject, Body, CC, BCC and a close: undo 1 took BCC, undo 2 took CC, undo 3 took the whole link. So a run of typing is one step, up to a press of CC or BCC or the close
email.reopen: the pill says Email, the fields are filled, CC and BCC shown when they hold a value, focus on the pill

phone.fields: Enter phone number with Clear, radios Call and Text, Call on by default
writes: the panel goes back to Attach link
phone.enter: on a number: the link stands and the editor closes, on a button and on text (<a href="tel:12345">). On an empty field the editor goes to the URL kind

reads: Email or Phone set, then URL
href empty, target=_blank, box on, field focused
href empty, no target, box on
href empty, no target, box on
after Phone then URL, /about and Enter
href /about, target=_blank kept, box read off (1 read)
switching.focus: the pill on File, Email and Phone; the field on URL

panelRow.look: a grey box 276 wide, icon, name, a smaller second line, then Edit, Copy and Remove Link in capitals

newTabControl: Open link in new tab is a switch, 28 by 14, at 164 in the popover, green when on

url.typedDomain: example.com/x and Enter writes the same with https in front; the panel row shows it alone, no second line
url.typedNoEnter: typed and closed without Enter: the link is written, on a button (https, read as typed) and on text (/about)
url.escape: with the list showing, the first Escape takes the list and the editor stays; the next closes it. 2 of 2 on text; this explains the button read in LINKBOX.json

learnMore: pressed once: Squarespace's help article on links opens in a new tab and the editor closes
emptyTo: Enter in an empty To leaves the editor open

boxOnButton.meaning: the canvas takes target from the box at the next link change, and the box reads off after Enter, 3 of 3 with the read after Phone then URL. What is saved needs a Save

textSwitch: a text link, then Email and a close with nothing filled: the link is gone, reopening shows URL, empty, box off
